requirements.requirement: The system must verify that identical input parameters produce identical cache keys.
The system must verify that differing input parameters produce different cache keys.
The system must confirm that a cache hit returns a previously stored quality score without recomputation.
The system must confirm that a cache miss triggers computation and persists the result to the cache.
The system must verify that cached entries expire after the configured TTL and are not returned afterward.
The system must verify that version changes invalidate existing cache entries.
The system must confirm that evaluate_care_facade returns identical responses with and without cache enabled for the same inputs.
The system must verify that cache-integrated evaluation reduces execution time compared to non-cached evaluation for repeated requests.
The system must confirm that corrupted cache entries trigger fallback recomputation and do not cause request failure.
The system must verify that partial or incomplete cache entries are ignored and recomputed.
The system must confirm that cache read failures (e.g., database unavailable) result in successful recomputation and response delivery.
The system must confirm that cache write failures do not block response delivery after computation.
The system must verify that integration tests through evaluate_care_facade exercise both cache hit and cache miss paths.
The system must confirm that cache keys include all required parameters (provider/trial ID, filters, weights) as defined in the schema.
